brief.zh: 小店需要按整数分计算优惠的工具。实现优惠门槛、边界与错误返回，拒绝负值和小数，保留能被下一位维护者复现的测试。
brief.en: A shop needs a deterministic discount tool using integer cents. Implement boundary cases and reject negative or non-integer amounts.
